description: People of NASA, the usual suspects said we wouldn't make it far. But today, the PRODKILLERS are here to make history. We're a new coalition that doesn't just sell smoke—we deliver code! We seek brilliant minds tired of the bugs of the past; we need experts in frontend, backend, design, or eating pupusas. Join this great space nation plan and together we will build the greatest project in history. May God bless our repo!
